skill_name: Research one of the most common ethical issues related to data collection.
workflow: One of the most common ethical issues related to data collection is the risk of data being used without people's knowledge or consent. Data can be obtained without consent through online tracking tools, cookies, online surveys, or other means. Data collected without permission can be used to make automated decisions, such as credit scoring or job applications, or manipulated to serve a certain agenda.
